artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape with a River and Castle
artworks.medium: black chalk and white chalk on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Merritt P. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with an elevated perspective looking out towards a scene. A village with a church steeple is visible across a stream, with a mountain rising on the right. A stone structure is situated on the mountain slope. The image is monochromatic, likely created with charcoal, showcasing soft shades and textures on trees and rocks. The color palette is limited to earthy tones. Rocks and trees in the foreground lead the eye towards the distant elements of the landscape.

artworks.title: Colonel John T. Croxton
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man, from the waist up. He is sitting with one arm resting on a draped table and the other holding a military cap. The man has a serious expression, featuring a full beard and mustache, with neatly combed medium-length hair parted at the side. He is dressed in a dark military uniform with double-breasted buttons and shoulder insignias, indicating a rank of officer. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Workers with Cotton Wagon, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on the edge of a container filled with cotton. He has one leg bent and resting on the container while the other leg hangs down. The man wears a headwrap, a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and an apron-like garment. In the background, there is a wooden building, with another person faintly visible through a window. An animal, likely a mule, is partially visible in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Woman Weaving a Basket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her body slightly turned, hands resting on a partly woven basket. She has high cheekbones, dark hair pulled back, and a focused expression. She wears a patterned, long-sleeved blouse and a long skirt made of light fabric. The background is blurred, possibly a wooden surface, suggesting an outdoor setting. No jewelry is visible, but the basket's weaving material stands out. The scene conveys a moment of quiet concentration in a rustic environment.

artworks.title: Young Painter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of an individual's face and part of the upper body. The person is in a seated position, facing slightly to the side with their face turned towards the camera, giving a partial profile view. The person has a full head of dark hair styled in a wavy manner and is wearing a light-colored collared shirt. In front of them is a large, round object resembling an artist's palette. The background is a plain, smooth surface with a neutral tone.

artworks.title: Moses Striking the Rock
artworks.medium: etching and engraving printed on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures surrounding a rocky outcrop. The drawing shows individuals gathered around, with some gesturing towards the rocky outcrop. The central figure is holding a staff towards the rock, while others display reactions of awe, desperation, or pleading. The composition features flowing garments and a sense of movement, with some figures lying on the ground and others interacting energetically. The detailed rendering of the rocky backdrop and expressive postures of the figures contribute to the dramatic narrative of the scene.

artworks.title: Moyses infantulus in Carecto ripae Nili a parentibus expositus (Baby Moses Placed in the Nile by his Parents)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving printed on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a pastoral scene with a river, trees, and a distant castle. The illustration shows figures engaged in different activities by the water's edge. On the left, a couple is seen reclining under a tree, with a basket and a jar nearby. In the foreground, a figure appears to be reaching into the water, with a small floating object in front. The landscape includes lush trees, rolling hills, and a castle structure with turrets and towers.

artworks.title: Mission San Diego
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image contains a drawing featuring two large trees on either side, and an old mission-style building with curved gables in the distance on a low hill. The horizon is implied just below the structure. The ink work appears light and sketchy with delicate, expressive brushstrokes adding texture to the foliage of the trees and rough terrain. The color palette is monochrome sepia-toned with variations in intensity conveying depth and detail.

artworks.title: Christ at the Table of Simon the Pharisee
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century, after Frans Floris I
artworks.medium: etching and chiaroscuro woodcut printed in gray-green on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table. The scene depicts a long, rectangular table covered with a cloth and adorned with various plates and cups. A gathering of nine figures is seated around the table, each characterized by flowing robes and expressive gestures that suggest active conversation or interaction. One figure is depicted kneeling on the ground, bending towards the feet of another individual seated at the table. The background is detailed with architectural elements, including draped curtains and columns. The lines and cross-hatching create a chiaroscuro effect, emphasizing the contours and folds in the garments and the detailed facial expressions.

artworks.title: Christ at the Table of Simon the Pharisee
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century, after Frans Floris I
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a group of people gathered around a dining table. The scene includes multiple figures seated around the table, with one person kneeling at the feet of another. The seated individuals are depicted in various poses, with some leaning forward or gesturing with their hands. The figures have distinct facial features, including eyes, noses, and mouths, with many having beards or long hair. The individuals are dressed in robes and flowing garments that reach the floor. The kneeling person is shown washing or anointing the feet of a seated individual, holding a small container in their left hand. The table is set with platters, cups, and a knife, and is covered with fabric. The background includes architectural elements like columns and draped curtains, indicating an indoor setting with structured design elements.

artworks.title: Love
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. She is standing in the center, wearing draped robes. Two other children are present, one naked and one holding a shepherd's crook. The background features swirling lines indicating a sky and sparse vegetation on the ground. The scene is rendered in a detailed etching style.

artworks.title: Las Hilanderas (The Spinners)
artworks.artist: Francisco Muntaner, after Agustín Esteve, after Diego Velázquez
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of six women engaging in textile work. Five of them are actively participating in the foreground, while others are visible through a large archway in the background. The women in the foreground are working with spinning wheels and spools. One woman is operating a spinning wheel, while a young girl gathers yarn from the floor beside her. Another woman is winding yarn onto a spool, while a woman beside her is seated and focused on her work. A fifth woman leans in from the left. In the background, a woman seems to be gesturing towards others. The women are wearing simple dresses and bodices typical of a working environment. Other details include a ladder, a drawn-back curtain, a circular design on the ceiling, a window casting light into the room, and a cat among the balls of yarn on the floor.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait of the Artist Drawing on a Lithographic Stone
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is seated and holds a writing tablet in his left hand, while his right hand holds a pen poised above the surface as if in the act of writing or drawing. The man has sharp facial features, a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and distinctive sideburns. His hair is short and wavy, neatly styled atop his head. He wears a dark, buttoned coat with a high collar over a visible cravat tied around his neck, and sports a medal or insignia on his coat. The background is plain with a slight texture.

artworks.title: C.V.T. Co. Stillwater, Washington
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sandra S. Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a logging area with cut and fallen trees stretching into the distance. A tall pole with cables, steam rising machinery, scattered logs, and a rail track leading into the logging area are visible. In the background, a line of trees marks the horizon where the forest has not been cleared. A group of people is standing on the tracks to the left.

artworks.title: Oxford Breaker
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sandra S. Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial scene from an elevated viewpoint. It features a complex of interconnected buildings in an industrial setting with visible chimneys and church spires in the background. A large building with a sloped roof and a nearby tall structure, likely a smokestack, stands out in the center. The terrain is uneven with mounds of earth and stacks of lumber in the foreground. The color palette is in sepia tones, emphasizing the industrial atmosphere. The scene is highly detailed, showing the bustling environment of the era.

artworks.title: Head of a Sheep
artworks.medium: pastel over black chalk and touches of gouache on light gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from  Anonymous
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sheep's head. The image showcases the profile of a sheep's head with a variety of colors and textures. The wool is depicted with soft, layered strokes, and the face is detailed, highlighting the sheep's facial contours. The eye is drawn with care. The background is simple.

artworks.title: a) Head of a Young Girl; b) Head of a Young Girl
artworks.medium:
a) etching and aquatint on wove paper;
b) etching and aquatint retouched with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christian Lapeyre

artworks.title: The Battle of Munda
artworks.medium: pen, brush, and ink over black chalk on laid paper, incised for transfer
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund and Gift of Funds from Jimmy and Jessica Younger Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene. Numerous figures are engaged in combat on horseback in a dynamic landscape. The background consists of wavy lines suggesting distant landscapes or more troops. A large tree extends from the left foreground with flowing branches that create a natural frame on one side of the drawing. The monochrome brownish tones and expressive line work convey motion and emotion.

artworks.title: Young Woman Sitting near a Tree
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in profile from her upper body down, facing left. She has delicate facial features, an updo hairstyle, and wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with hands resting on her lap. Detailed foliage and floral patterns surround her in a natural setting. In the background are silhouettes of trees and a darker figure. Line work in the margins suggests an artistic touch.

artworks.title: Design for the Ceiling of the Salon of the Palazzo Spinola, Genoa
artworks.artist: Louis-Jean Desprez, after Charles de Wailly
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated ceiling. The image shows an elaborate architectural ceiling design, emphasizing an oval-shaped frame featuring a classical scene. The ceiling is decorated with intricate reliefs, classical motifs, and cherubic figures. The central oval scene depicts numerous figures, some riding chariots, surrounded by clouds, pointing to a heavenly or divine occurrence. The surrounding decorations showcase vases, rosettes, and possibly vegetal and floral designs, reflecting opulent baroque architectural style. The overall impression is one of grandeur and meticulous attention to detail typical of grand interior spaces from a classical period.

artworks.title: Cross Section of the Salon of the Palazzo Spinola, Genoa
artworks.artist: Louis-Jean Desprez, after Charles de Wailly
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated architectural interior. The room features a central archway flanked by two doors, adorned with carvings and relief sculptures. The central arch leads into a vestibule area showcasing a statue on a plinth. The ceiling is adorned with frescoes, and the space contains sculptures, floral motifs, columns with elaborate capitals, decorative vases, and a chandelier.

artworks.title: Perspectival View of the Salon of the Palazzo Spinola, Genoa
artworks.artist: Louis-Jean Desprez, after Charles de Wailly
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an ornate and grand interior space. The interior features a large hall or gallery with high ceilings and intricate architectural elements. The hall is adorned with tall, classical columns that line the walls, supporting the elaborate ceiling. The ceiling is rich with sculptural reliefs and frescoes. The floor is checkered with light and dark squares, adding to the sense of depth and perspective. The walls are intricately decorated with ornate moldings and detailed panels, some of which include sculptures. The overall atmosphere of the scene is one of opulence and classical grandeur, suggesting a setting of historical significance.

artworks.title: Saint Paschal Baylon in Ecstasy
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person levitating, surrounded by swirling lines. The person has their arms outstretched and head tilted upwards. They have soft facial features, rounded cheeks, and short hair. They wear a flowing robe with a belt and a rosary. In the background, two smaller figures are observing, one standing with hands near their chest and the other kneeling with arms raised. Above the central figure, there is an ornate object resembling a chalice or monstrance surrounded by clouds. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome sepia tone.

artworks.title: Aetas Ferrea (The Iron Age)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The foreground shows mounted figures engaged in a skirmish. In the background, a town or village is under attack, with smoke and fire visible. Various animals like horses and cattle are present. The composition is detailed and intricate, conveying movement and energy. Text at the bottom adds context to the events depicted.
